name: Harbor SMID Cap Value ETF

name: Gabelli High Income ETF
Amplify Weight Loss Drug & Treatment ETF

name: YieldMax Target 12 Real Estate Option Income ETF

name: Columbia Research Enhanced Small Cap ETF
fund_description: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF). The fund is non-diversified.

name: Calamos Bitcoin 80 Series Structured Alt Protection ETF - July
